scope: Short-input power-limit comparison; same running original-weight 24-request profile and same GPU assignment. Two repetitions per concurrency and power setting.
power_limit_order: Six selected GPUs in existing pipeline order; unused seventh GPU separately raised to 600 W.
caveat: The 24-stream results show substantial variation also seen in the earlier qualification. These short tests do not establish a causal percentage speedup or long-prefill benefit. No long-duration soak at 600 W was performed in this comparison.
